name: Quippy
long_description: Quippy is a daily practice app for your social life. You run short, realistic practice conversations, like pushing back on a boss or talking during a first date, and get line-by-line feedback on what landed and what backfired. The curriculum adapts to each person's patterns, reshaping itself around their weak spots, ensuring steady improvement in the conversations that matter most.
one_liner: Helps build social skills through daily practice

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder of Quippy. Most recently Head of Product at Luvu (a16z-backed), scaling from $0 to $1.5M ARR in 4 months. Previously APM at Duolingo, delivering $50.4M in ARR growth and helped build features including Video Call with Lily and Duolingo's first monolingual English course (280K DAUs in 4 months). Dual degree in CS and Business from the University of Michigan.
